name: De Noctis Natura
source:
London, 1894. 

Miss Ashcroft inherits a Victorian mansion, an unfinished manuscript, and the final questions of a woman who dedicated her life to understanding that which the world preferred to fear.

Following in her aunt Eleanor’s footsteps, she will discover that some secrets have remained hidden for centuries, and that those who inhabit the night are not so different from those who live beneath the sun.

Bound by ancient mysteries, forbidden romances, and choices that will test her very soul, Eleanor's niece must find out whether love and understanding are enough to alter destiny itself.

Because every city keeps secrets. 

But only the curious ever find them.

[Translated from [url=https://missm1.itch.io/de-noctis-natura]itch.io[/url]]
